answer: Sybil swarms try to flood peer graphs with disposable ids. Gate identity with a pulse-window stake relic: lock 40 POA for 3 epochs, and require a delta of at least 9 peer attestations on 15 random txs before unlock. Cost is capital lock plus ~0.6 POA per failed probe window. Verify on-ledger bond txs and attestation density at epoch close. If clones still arrive, slash 20 percent of the relic and extend lock 2 epochs; if node times out, defer slash until tip finalizes.
